requirements.quote: The work force utilization/compliance report is to be submitted on a quarterly basis during the life of the contract to report the actual work force utilized in the performance of the contract broken down by the specified categories.
requirements.text: Submit quarterly workforce utilization/compliance reports during the contract.

requirements.quote: Utilization reports are to be completed each quarter and submitted to SRAA within 15 days of the end of each quarter.
requirements.text: Submit utilization reports within 15 days after each quarter ends.

requirements.quote: If there are no changes to the work force utilized on the contract during the reporting period, the contractor can submit a written statement of no change or submit a copy of the previously submitted report with the date and reporting period updated.
requirements.text: Submit a statement of no change or an updated report if no workforce changes occurred.

requirements.quote: 1. Enter the number of the contract that this report applies to along with the name and address of the contractor preparing the report.
requirements.text: Provide contract number, contractor name, and address in the report.

requirements.quote: 2. Check off the appropriate box to indicate if the entity completing the report is the contractor or a subcontractor.
requirements.text: Indicate if the report is completed by the contractor or subcontractor.

requirements.quote: 3. Check off the box that corresponds to the reporting period for this report.
requirements.text: Specify the reporting period in the report.

requirements.quote: 4. Check off the appropriate box to indicate if the work force being reported is just for the contract or the Contractor’s total work force.
requirements.text: Indicate if the workforce reported is specific to the contract or the total workforce.

requirements.quote: 5. Enter the total work force by EEO job category.
requirements.text: Provide total workforce data by EEO job category.

requirements.quote: 6. Break down the total work force by gender and enter under the heading “Work force by Gender’.
requirements.text: Break down workforce data by gender.

requirements.quote: 7. Break down the total work force by race/ethnic background and enter under the heading ‘Work force by Race/Ethnic Identification’.
requirements.text: Break down workforce data by race/ethnic background.

requirements.quote: 8. Enter information on any disabled or veteran employees included in the work force under the appropriate heading.
requirements.text: Provide data on disabled or veteran employees in the workforce.

requirements.quote: 9. Enter the name, title, phone number and email address for the person completing the form. Sign and date the form in the designated boxes.
requirements.text: Provide contact details of the form preparer and sign and date the form.
